title: Howard Morland reconstructs the Teller-Ulam H-bomb design for The Progressive

tellings.quote: another guy named Howard Morland who heard that name >> who worked for the progressive magazine and he had the assignment see if you can figure out with no knowledge of physics the teller ulam design for the hydrogen bomb

plain: In 1979 a writer for The Progressive magazine named Howard Morland was given an assignment: with no knowledge of physics, see if he could work out the secret design of the hydrogen bomb, known as the Teller-Ulam design. The researcher Eric Weinstein tells the story without naming a source, setting it against the Atomic Energy Acts of 1946 and 1954, US laws that made nuclear knowledge secret. He uses it to show how far government secrecy over physics can reach, and how an outsider can still piece it together.
